description: Resolve a board URL or ID and create the board if missing. If an active MCP session exists, attempt to subscribe it to board updates. Returns the canonical ID, a summary (item counts, authors), and `auto_subscribed` to indicate registration success. For confirmed subscription or long-lived push, call `resources/subscribe` and use the session's event stream. Use this tool only when automatic creation and a subscription attempt are intended. To inspect an existing board without creating it or subscribing, pass its ID to `get_board` or `get_preview`.

access_key.description: Board key for direct MCP clients that handle credentials outside chat. Accepts an 8-character key or a legacy 6-character key. Keep the key out of chat and use the browser or an MCP client configured with the X-Board-Key header.

url_or_id.description: Full board URL (https://cnvs.app/#<id>) or bare UUID.

name: open_board
title: Open Board
